topic_zh: 系统设计到底在考什么：一张图看懂从一台机器到百万用户
topic_en: What system design tests: from one machine to a million users

xhs.title: 系统设计考什么？一张图看懂
xhs.body:
面试被要求「设计一个百万用户的系统」，别慌，从一台机器开始画：
一台机器 → 拆出数据库 → 负载均衡 + 多台服务器 → 缓存
每一步都在回答三个问题：瓶颈在哪？加什么？代价是什么？
没有标准答案，只有取舍。总结图建议收藏～
考考你：网站只有一台服务器，挂了全站打不开。A 加缓存，B 加负载均衡和多台服务器，哪个能解决？评论区告诉我～

tiktok.body:
"Design a system for a million users." Start with one machine, then fix one bottleneck at a time.
Quiz: one server, it dies, the site is down. Fix it with A) a cache or B) a load balancer plus more servers?

linkedin.title: System design interviews test one habit, not a list of components.
linkedin.body:
Start with one machine. Then grow it one bottleneck at a time:
split out the database, add a load balancer and more servers, add a cache.
Every step answers three questions: where is the bottleneck, what do we add, and what does it cost?
There is no perfect answer, only trade-offs you can explain.
Quick quiz: your site runs on one server and goes down when it dies. Which fixes that: A) a cache, or B) a load balancer plus more servers?

quiz.q_zh: 网站只有一台服务器，它一挂全站打不开。A 加缓存，B 加负载均衡和多台服务器，哪个能解决？
quiz.q_en: Your site runs on one server and goes down when it dies. Which fixes that: A) a cache, or B) a load balancer plus more servers?
quiz.answer_zh: 答案：B。缓存只让读更快，服务器挂了照样打不开；负载均衡会把请求转给还活着的服务器。
quiz.answer_en: Answer: B. A cache only makes reads faster; a load balancer sends requests to the servers that are still alive.
